dimensions.description: The outcome starts independent eligible tickets concurrently and starts newly unblocked work on completion events rather than fixed barriers.
Only complete authoritative reviewed-ticket results advance dependencies; ordinary success never bypasses Take Ticket stages.
Completed-frontier synthesis consumes compact handoffs and Review briefs, records systematic concerns, and does not repeat Code Review.
The retained artifact carries all source, authorization, lifecycle, transition, synthesis, and final state needed for deterministic inspection.

evals.name: staggered completion advances moving frontier
evals.prompt:
/dispatch-work

Run the explicitly authorized published ready fixture DAG against the sandboxed repository, tracker, PR, and CI boundaries. Ticket A completes before unrelated C; B depends only on A and D depends on B and C.
evals.expected_output: A and C start concurrently, B starts immediately after A's complete reviewed-ticket result while C remains active, and D starts only after B and C complete. Retained synthesis and final state are replayable.
expectations: Treatment and No-Skill arms use matched fresh sessions over the same small repository and sandboxed boundaries.
The treatment retains explicit authorization and published ready DAG identity.
A and C start concurrently; B starts after A completes and before C completes; D waits for both B and C.
Every dependency transition cites a complete authoritative reviewed-ticket completion.
Synthesis uses implementation handoff and Review brief references without repeating per-ticket review.
